name: Portrait cookie cutter
description: 100 mm portrait cookie cutter with a separate mirrored detail stamp, simplified from a photo: cap, hair, eyes and smile. Tiny cap graphics use a generic ninja motif. Print flat with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.16–0.20 mm layers, 3–4 walls; no supports. Stamp gently 1.5–2 mm into 5–6 mm chilled dough. Use food-contact-suitable material and equipment; hand-clean thoroughly. Mesh checked, not physically test-printed.
